scientific_integrity: The characteristic-two classification is proved from the basis-pair Rota–Baxter identities. Exhaustive checks over F_2 and F_4 recover the full solution set and automorphism orbits; F_3 is checked only as a boundary contrast. The closest same-object complex classification is explicitly treated as prior coverage outside the accepted characteristic-two claim.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to finite fields of characteristic two, the cubic truncation, and weight zero. It does not classify higher truncations or nonzero weights, and it records residual risk from unindexed positive-characteristic literature.
title: Characteristic-two Rota–Baxter operators on the cubic truncated polynomial algebra
